mapper.insert: INSERT INTO after_sale (id, after_sale_no, order_no, customer_id, type, reason, status, refund_amount) VALUES (#{id}, #{afterSaleNo}, #{orderNo}, #{customerId}, #{type}, #{reason}, #{status}, #{refundAmount})
mapper.select: SELECT id, after_sale_no, order_no, customer_id, type, reason, status, refund_amount, created_at, updated_at FROM after_sale WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
